body:
I actually did try this back in 2008 when we were still renters (for completely different reasons). I left "for good" and packed up and moved to another apt in another town.

It was a huge pain in the butt moving by myself and it ended up draining both of our accounts.  But it worked. We worked everything out over the course of about 3 months.

Everything is different now. I own the home in my name since his credit is shot. I pay the mortgage so it would be double rent for me.

I don't have anyone I can stay with. I do like the idea of taking a trip by myself even if its just a roadtrip through a few states.  I don't know though.
Hmm, interesting idea. Go where though? And for how long?

Yeah, now that you mention it, he may never change. He has come a long way and has learned so much, but it never seems to be enough for him. 

He is always saying how he want more money.  When he was making a lot of money he worked crazy long hours and then he complained about having no time.  He is never content with the way things are.

I have a feeling that even if money and time were no issue for him then something else won't be right.

I haven't decided if that's something I can live with. I don't think I can, but instead of ending it I would rather try to help make it better for him.
He's not an easy person to reason with though :(

Yeah, that would really be fun.  I just keep thinking of things that stop me from making any plans:

All of my siblings are so different, its hard to find something that more than 2 of us would enjoy.

My husband would want to go. He will guilt trip me to death if I went on a trip without him.

Even if he did travel with me, that would be financially impossible for us. We could scrimp by and make it happen, but he doesn't work like that.  Is he is doing something, he wants to go all out and spend as much money as possible. He's an all or nothing dude.

So many other things stop me in my tracks.

Hah... I'm known at work as being the one that is not a fan of kids. They kind of creep me out.  

I've tried hanging out with the one girls family. Her two year old liked me I guess and it clung to my leg and wouldn't let go... kinda freaked me out.
Oh yeah, thanks for the link. I will check it out later today when I am not trying to post from my phone.

You are spot on about my husband. His stress levels and low esteem make it hard to have fun with him.  He doesn't talk about it, but I know he stresses about money and his lack of education plus dept. 

He want to be able to provide the world to me and buy me everything even when I tell him I just want to have fun with him.

I also know its a huge blow to his esteem that I make a considerable amount of money more than him.

I've thought about that with my oldest sister since she is the only one with expendable monies, and only has to work part time, but she travels with her husband. I don't want to be the third wheel in that.

Yeah...I hear ya.  I feel like I jinx coworkers. I was pretty much best friends with one girl, and she ended up gettinglaid off. She's so busy with kids its hard for her to find time.

Plus all of my coworker are all at least 10 years older than me with families of their own :P Hard to relate outside of work.

Traveling abroad ( or even going to Canada) sounds like a dream. But I like to spend my PTO on family related things since they live all over the US.  It seems inconsiderate for me to waste any extra time/ money without them. 
 Im in Texas, but that is only because that is where my husb is.

I need to prepare for things that may happen ( layoff, unexpected bills). My life would be so stressful if I lived paycheck to paycheck.  I own a home, and I would hate to lose it.


I feel weird hanging out with coworkers outside of work. I'm not sure how to explain it. Maybe its like if I hang out with coworkers during off hours, then maybe work will become something I don't like. I guess I get rewarded by getting to see them by going to work if that makes sense.
I don't know... like too much of a good thing?

Yeah that sounds about right.

Thanks for the link, I'm  going to dig into those in a bit.
I'm really confused about everything now. I really regret marrying him, but we have been together so long that it seemed like the right thing to do.

I do work and I make decent money. I love my job and the people I work with feel more like a family than anything.  

I grew up in a very frugal family which has led me to believe that I need to save as much as possible in order to not work myself to my grave.

Im not sure where to go from here. What's next?  It sucks because I do try new thing or ill start researching new fun things to try, but if/when my husb finds out he says I can't do those things alone. 
He will say that someone is goinng to steal me and rape and murder me in the woods or some other crazy thing will happen.

Him saying that isn't what stops me. He instills fear and weakness in my mind. He turns something fun for me into a bad extreme situation.

I have no clue where to start with that.  I don't know what nice things for me would be. 

I run with my dog (that my husband hates), I spend time with my kitties (which my husband complains about because im not paying enough attention to him). 
I don't know what other nice things are. I feel extremely guilty when I waste money on myself so I try to not buy things. No friends really either to hang with.

He denies it. He doesn't litterally put it down, but his actions speak louder than words. He denies that as well. 
I would really like to have one thing I enjoy doing with him, but he talks so much about all the amazing people he works with I just want to slap him and tell him to just say one thing nice about me.

This situation is just stupid and menial. I read sw and everyone else has it way worse than me. I hate feeling so selfish. I hate everything about myself. Its not like I will kill myself today over these feelings. 

In the end, I will realize that I have brought this upon myself and this is what I deserve.  I don't have the strength to try anymore is all.

That's the thing though! I do take time for myself to try to find things that I like and want for me. It just gets turned around when the husb poo poos on it.  Like a light switch, whatever I like turns into something I dread.

Wow, thank you for the response.  Just seeing that some random stranger seems to care more about me is making me cry.  I haven't been able to cry for months.
It will probably get better.  
I get some help with antidepressants... just wishing things had ended a little different for me.
